# events

`node:events`-shaped `EventEmitter` — the clearest example of the
`node_modules/` side of SEVM: pure JavaScript, framework level.

## Usage

```js
import { EventEmitter } from './node_modules/events/index.js';

const bus = new EventEmitter();
bus.on('ping', (n) => console.log('pong', n));
bus.emit('ping', 42);
```

## API

`on` · `once` · `off` · `emit` · `listenerCount` · `removeAllListeners`
